name: authorize
sig:
authorize({ principal, privilege, resource? })
  : AuthorizeResult
what: Whether a principal’s roles hold one named privilege on a resource. Every control-plane route calls it with exactly one privilege.
rules: Roles map to privileges in one table inside the Bouncer.
agent-owner, agent-member and requester come from data, never from a credential.
A role check outside packages/bouncer and packages/auth fails conformance.
A route missing from the matrix test fails conformance.

name: checkHold
sig:
checkHold(request, rule: HoldRule)
  : HoldDecision
what: Whether an outbound request is held for a person’s approval, using the agent’s hold rules.
rules: The Bouncer decides; the egress enforces.
A held request stores a reviewed copy, its hash and a size-limited body.
The limits are HELD_BODY_LIMIT and HELD_STORED_BODY_LIMIT.

name: checkToolApproval
sig:
checkToolApproval(check: ToolApprovalCheck)
  : ToolApprovalDecision
what: Whether a tool call needs a person’s approval, and whether an approval already covers it.
rules: An approval is consumed when used.

name: checkStanding
sig:
checkStanding(request: StandingRequest)
  : StandingResult
what: Whether an agent is inside its limits. Returns ok, or the first window exceeded: perRun, perDay or perMonth.
rules: The Treasurer decides; callers enforce (402, blockRun, budget.alert).
No default budget exists. Without one, nothing is enforced.
A conformance test fails if egress or control-plane source compares spend with a limit itself.

name: costUsd / priceFor
sig:
priceFor(model): Price
costUsd(price: Price, usage: TokenUsage)
  : number
what: Turns the Executive’s token counts into dollars. TokenUsage is input, output, cacheRead and cacheWrite.
rules: The Executive depends on the Treasurer for the Price and TokenUsage types only.

name: complete
sig:
complete(request, catalog, adapters)
  : Promise<Completion>
what: Serves one model call: validates the request, finds the provider’s adapter and calls it. Never throws.
rules: Returns a result, a refusal made before any provider was called, or the upstream failure.
The Executive holds no credential and answers no HTTP request.

name: checkModel / offeredModels
sig:
checkModel(policy: ModelPolicy, name)
  : ModelCheck
offeredModels(policy): string[]
what: Whether an agent may use a model, and which models it may choose from.
rules: Plain values in. The Executive does not import the control plane’s Policy.
Factory default applies when a policy names none (M2, E7).

name: createInspector
what: The one door for run events, live progress and ledger taps.
rules: The Inspector watches and decides nothing.
A conformance test fails on a second copy of the event hub.

name: createTimekeeper
what: Each minute, tells the Landlord which cartridge crons and which schedules are due.
rules: It never starts a run and never imports the control plane.
The composition root is its only caller.

name: admit
sig: admit(source, { build, isRefusal, redact })
what: Admits or refuses a pinned commit. The Landlord injects the image build.
rules: Only a pinned, admitted commit deploys (L3, L4).
A refusal carries one reason.

name: AgentRegistry
what: The agent record and the store behind it.
rules: AgentRecord lives in the Registrar. The Landlord and the Keymaster import it from there.

name: VersionedConfigStore
sig:
VersionedConfigStore
configHash(config): string
what: Versioned deployment configuration, including the owners the Bouncer reads.
rules: configHash does not change when owners are absent.
A versioned backend allows point-in-time restore (R1).

name: SystemsStore
sig: SystemsStore
what: System definitions (E10). The Keymaster derives a connection provider from one.
rules: The store moved without a Keymaster dependency; the control plane adds the two Keymaster methods.

name: Keymaster.checkout
sig:
checkout(params: CheckoutParams)
  : Promise<CheckoutOutcome>
what: A credential for one outbound call, as a lease.
rules: Agents never hold real secrets (S1).
A lease expires or is revoked.

name: SecretProvider
what: Maps a secret’s name to the vault that holds it. One provider per landing zone.
rules: Names only travel; values stay in the vault.
Writes are through a writable provider, write-only.

name: pullMind / pushMind
sig:
pullMind(store: MindStore, prefix, dest)
pushMind(store: MindStore, prefix, src)
what: Copies an agent’s prefix between the mind store and $MEMORY_DIR.
rules: The prefix is fixed at deploy.
Cartridges never need a cloud storage SDK.

name: LedgerStore / verifyChain
sig:
LedgerStore  (FileLedger, MemoryLedger)
verifyChain(rows, genesis): VerifyResult
Checkpointer, LedgerLease
what: Append a redacted, hash-chained row; verify the chain; seal checkpoints.
rules: Rows are append-only.
Secrets and prompts are redacted before storage.

name: AuthProvider / Principal
what: Who is calling and with what roles. Authentication only.
rules: Roles: viewer, operator, approver, ingest, gatekeeper-egress, gatekeeper-ingress, admin.
It authenticates and never authorizes.

name: GatekeeperIngress
what: How a message reaches a sleeping agent, and how the Landlord reports the agent’s state back.
rules: Discord is an optional mailbox, not a requirement.
The ingress keeps its socket when the agent scales to zero.

name: createRun and the run lifecycle
what: Wake, run and stop an agent. Every wake path goes through createRun.
rules: Every wake path goes through createRun.
A replayed messageId returns the existing run with 200.
The functions take LandlordState; the queue pollers and the Timekeeper’s fire take createRun as a callback, so the package never imports the control plane.
A conformance test fails on a second copy of these rules.
